verses.zh: 誰 如 智 慧 人 呢 ？ 誰 知 道 事 情 的 解 釋 呢 ？ 人 的 智 慧 使 他 的 臉 發 光 ， 並 使 他 臉 上 的 暴 氣 改 變 。
verses.en: Who is[NOTE:1] a[NOTE:2] wise person? Who knows the solution[NOTE:3] to a problem?[NOTE:4] A person’s wisdom brightens his appearance[NOTE:5] and softens[NOTE:6] his harsh countenance.[NOTE:7]

The BHS editors and the Hebrew Old Testament Text Project adopt אֶת as the original reading. See D. Barthélemy, ed., Preliminary and Interim Report on the Hebrew Old Testament Text Project, 3:582-83.

verses.en: So I recommend the enjoyment of life,[NOTE:1] for there is nothing better on earth[NOTE:2] for a person to do[NOTE:3] except[NOTE:4] to eat, drink, and enjoy[NOTE:5] life.[NOTE:6] So[NOTE:7] joy[NOTE:8] will accompany him in his toilduring the days of his life that God gives him on earth.[NOTE:9]
